audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[N].side read Yone and agree with win[N] and the packet, but every phases[N].why under them described LUX winning that stage — the generic Lux template was never re-pointed.
audit.why: Same defect class as the 189 reverted rows: row verdict and the sentence beneath it argued with each other on all seven stages.
audit.corrected: All seven whys rewritten from the Yone-wins verdict using real numbers: Mortal Steel 450 range / 4s, Spirit Cleave 700 range / 14s shield, Soul Unbound 22/19/16/13/10s, Fate Sealed 120/100/80s at 1000 range. Sides and win[N] already agree, so no chart-group edits were made.

audit.why: spikes[] has all four entries and tracks the kit correctly: the Q-stack knockup plus Soul Unbound at 3-5, Fate Sealed at 6, crit/shield sustain at first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags it exactly: the page never named a single Yone ability outside the tracked-cooldown line, and carried zero sequencing cues. Missing entirely: Mortal Steel needs TWO stacks before it dashes and knocks up (so a spent gust leaves him a 450-range melee), Spirit Cleave's shield scales with the number of champions hit, and Fate Sealed blinks him behind the LAST champion in the line and pulls everyone toward him — which is why standing at the back of your own wave is standing inside his engage.
audit.why: Riot text for Q, W and R states each of these directly; none of it had reached the page.
audit.corrected: Named abilities and their real numbers now appear in the cooldowns field, the whys, both trade lines, enemyWin, and five dos/donts bodies.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all, and dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second invitation' for an ability that is on 22s at rank 1.
audit.why: Lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT plus a magnitude with no source. Soul Unbound's rank scaling (22 down to 10s) is the actual punish schedule.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field rewritten with Soul Unbound 22-to-10s, Fate Sealed 120s, Spirit Cleave 14s and Lux's 10s Q; the fabricated fifteen seconds is gone.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, under unrelated titles; the remaining bullet bodies were enemy-agnostic templates.
audit.why: Lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED x2 plus the mandatory template sweep.
audit.corrected: Six bullet bodies rewritten in-band, each matching its own title and grounded in Yone's kit.

edits.before: E-poke from max range on his last-hits — the slow zone plus passive auto is your chip engine from level 1.
edits.after: His Mortal Steel is 450 range on a 4s cooldown, and Spirit Cleave shields whatever your level 1 poke lands.

edits.before: Q joins: the root threat re-prices every step he takes past the wave's midline.
edits.after: At 2 he has two of Q, W and E — enough to commit before your Q comes back.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-E-auto with the passive detonations is a real chunk. Shield his answer and walk.
edits.after: Level 3: two Mortal Steel stacks dash him in with a knockup, and Soul Unbound is a 22s commit.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — E every wave contact. Bank Manaflow and hold Q for his aggression, not yours.
edits.after: Soul Unbound falls from 22s to 13s by rank 4 — his commit window returns faster than your Q.

edits.before: Final Spark online — anything the root catches dies to the laser math. The lane becomes a geometry quiz.
edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks him behind the last champion in the line and drags you in — his 6 beats your skillshot.

edits.before: Luden's spike: Q-E-R deletes squishies from root range. Force him to dodge or die on every contact.
edits.after: His first item makes Spirit Cleave's 14s shield hold through your combo while he autos you down.

edits.before: Late Lux decides fights from a screen away: root the entry, slow the pit, and laser the clump your team froze.
edits.after: Two dashes plus a 1000-range Fate Sealed close every gap you make — the team holds him or you die.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. It governs your forward steps. - W Prismatic Barrier spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound: 22s at rank 1 falling to 10s at rank 5 — that number is your whole step-up schedule. - Fate Sealed is 120s at rank 1 and pulls from 1000 range. - Spirit Cleave shields him every 14s. - Your Q is 10s: hold it to peel, not to poke.

edits.before: His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Mortal Steel needs two stacks to dash; once he has spent that gust he is a 450-range melee with no gap-closer for 4s.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, weave the passive auto, and keep Q visibly loaded — the chip is free and the root threat does the zoning.
edits.after: Prismatic Barrier is 12s at rank 1 — spend it on the Fate Sealed pull or the knockup follow-up, not on the chip he does walking in.

edits.before: Yone burns Soul Unbound on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Final Spark is 60s at rank 1 and reaches 3340 units — punish the walk back.

edits.before: That’s Yone’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Q is 10s; a Mortal Steel dash beats a predicted bind and leaves you with nothing.

edits.before: Your W answers exactly one combo per fight — shield the spell that kills, not the one that stings.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave is 700 range and shields him; inside it with your 10s Q down you cannot stop the knockup.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown and facing the dive with an empty root slot — Lux without the binding banked is everyone's favorite snack.
edits.after: Fate Sealed hits the last champion in a line from 1000 range — standing at the wave's edge is standing inside his engage.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, weave the passive auto, and keep Q visibly loaded — the chip is free and the root threat does the zoning.
edits.after: E the ground behind his last-hit and detonate as he steps — chip him while Mortal Steel has no stacks, and bank Q for the dash.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown and facing the dive with an empty root slot — Lux without the binding banked is everyone's favorite snack.
edits.after: Q-poking while Soul Unbound is up — he commits out of fog the second your root goes on its 10-second cooldown and you have no peel.

edits.before: Good trade: E the contact, detonate, weave the passive auto, and keep Q visibly loaded — the chip is free and the root threat does the zoning. Bad trade: Q-poking on cooldown and facing the dive with an empty root slot — Lux without the binding banked is everyone's favorite snack.
edits.after: Good trade: E the ground behind his last-hit and detonate as he steps — chip him while Mortal Steel has no stacks, and bank Q for the dash. Bad trade: Q-poking while Soul Unbound is up — he commits out of fog the second your root goes on its 10-second cooldown and you have no peel.

edits.before: Yone wins by landing Soul Unbound, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Yone wins by committing on Soul Unbound, stacking Mortal Steel into a knockup, and pulling you back with Fate Sealed.

edits.before: Carry through the root-laser pipeline — one binding per fight, converted at screen range; your job is owning the geometry that makes it land.
edits.after: Carry by punishing Soul Unbound's downtime: bind the knockup dash, detonate E under him, and laser him before Spirit Cleave shields it.

notes: The packet's two defects are addressed: Yone's abilities are now named on the page and the cooldowns field carries concrete wait-for-X sequencing. All seven full-layer whys had the row verdict pointing at Yone while the sentence described Lux winning; all seven were re-pointed, sides untouched (they already matched win[N]). The commonly-cited Soul Unbound behaviour where damage taken by the spirit is delayed is NOT in Riot's text, so it is not asserted anywhere in these edits.
